summary: With no subplan you complete the Theater and Performance Studies concentration: TAPS 1, 4 units of theater and dance studies, TAPS 39, 7 practicum units and 8 elective units in TAPS or DANCE. The Dance Subplan replaces it with DANCE 11 or TAPS 1, theater and dance studies, 7 units of dance practice, TAPS 39 and electives. Either way the minor is 24 units, and the practicum or dance practice classes, which the Bulletin describes without a list, are moved in by hand.

iV72O6IU.why: "All theater and dance practice classes (such as those in acting, design, playwriting, directing, and dance practice) may count towards this requirement." No list says which classes are practice classes, so the student moves 7 units in.

EOAfvHrK.why: "Electives (8 units)": "All courses in TAPS and DANCE qualify as electives." The stored 14-unit floor disagrees with the heading's 8.

WWWG5FD3.why: "A minimum of seven units of dance practice in technique, choreography, and performance are required. At least three classes are chosen from a specific dance form ... and the attainment of intermediate or advanced level. At least two classes in a style other than the student's primary chosen dance form." Dance forms and levels are not in the course data.

JRA221vb.why: "Electives (8 units)": "All courses in TAPS and DANCE qualify as electives." The stored 14-unit floor disagrees with the heading's 8.

iG1X0j6b.why: The Bulletin marks a subplan as not required, and the minor's only requirements outside the "Dance Subplan" are the "Theater and Performance Studies Concentration" (named after the minor itself), so that block is what a student with no subplan completes; choosing the Dance Subplan replaces it.
